snippet.title: Gravity Blasters - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Gravity Blasters announcement trailer to learn about this real-time multiplayer game that recreates the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power. 

Set in a chaotic, gravity-bending galaxy, Gravity Blasters pits players against waves of alien foes in high-octane battles that demand speed, strategy, and precision. From gravity bombs to reverse-pull grenades, every power-up opens new ways to dominate the battlefield while gravity zones flip the rules of engagement at any moment. Gravity Blasters will be available on PC.
